issue.title: NAT vs tests depend on sonic-buildimage changes

failure.body: The NAT vs tests have a dependency on Azure/sonic-buildimage#3494. Once that PR is merged, the tests need to be re-enabled in swss.

resolution.title: [dvs] Add NAT tests back to test suite
resolution.description:
- Validate that NAT processes are running on dvs
- Mark tests as xfail so results can be monitored

Signed-off-by: Danny Allen <<EMAIL>>

Fixes #1178
Introduces #1199
